venda: Use case: style-transfer. Create a production-ready HIGH RESOLUTION HAND-PAINTED 2D GAME ASSET SHEET, square 2048x2048 canvas containing exactly FOUR complete exterior views of the SAME building in an evenly spaced 2x2 grid. Image 1 is ONLY the building architectural identity reference; image 2 (the tavern) is ONLY the rendering STYLE reference. Redraw image 1 with the tavern's rich smoothly painted material detail, sculpted readable forms, clear wood grain, dimensional individual stones and ceramic tiles, selective warm outlines, soft painted shading and crisp antialiased contours. Eliminate ALL chunky pixels, pixel staircases and quantized texture. Keep the source building's distinct architecture, roof colors, proportions, doors, windows and attached objects, not the tavern architecture. The general store: orange terracotta roof, chimney at left, timber and cream plaster, centered door with red/cream striped awning and gold coin sign, display windows with groceries, crates and sacks beside the doorway. Elevated orthographic front facing RPG view, no side rotation, all four houses exactly the same perspective, identical scale and positioned at the same relative location in their quadrants, same front threshold anchor and wall geometry. Grid order: upper left SPRING (fresh leaves and flowers), upper right SUMMER (lush deeper leaves, flowers reduced), lower left AUTUMN (gold and amber foliage, same roof color), lower right WINTER (natural continuous rounded snow caps on exposed roof surfaces, sills and props; dormant/bare climbing plants; dark open chimney mouth; door and steps accessible). Preserve detailed painted material rendering equally in ALL four versions. Each full building fits within its own square quadrant with about 7% transparent margin on all sides; no contact across quadrants, no cutoffs. Transparent background in every quadrant and all gutters. NO ground plane, NO colored background, NO large shadow, NO text, NO season names, NO labels, NO layout borders, NO extra objects, NO changes in architecture between seasons. Final textures will be 4x logical resolution on a 16-unit RPG grid: prioritize strong readable material forms over noisy microtexture.
